name: Family demo
short_desc: Family server with demo data or a copy of the real data, for testing dev builds. Start only while testing.
author: Florian Geymayer
description: A second Family server for testing dev builds, never the real family's log: the invented Familie Muster (codes ANNA0001 admin, BEN00001) or a copy of the real Family data, taken from a read-only mount while Family keeps running. The dev app switches between them and pairs itself; this app's Data setting is the fallback. Start it only while testing and stop it afterwards: the homelab has little RAM to spare (capped at 200 MB, half a CPU).

form_fields.label: Data

options.label: Chosen in the dev app (demo until it switches)
Copy of the real Family data

form_fields.hint: Which dataset the demo server runs on. 'Chosen in the dev app' follows the dev build's Dev data switch; Demo and Copy override it. The copy is taken from the Family app's folder, mounted read-only, while it keeps running.

form_fields.label: Refresh the copy on every start
form_fields.hint: Copy mode: takes a new copy of the real data at every start while this is on. Turn it off again after the refresh; the dev app can ask for a refresh itself.

form_fields.label: Dev switch token
form_fields.hint: The token the dev app's Dev data section asks for; valid on this demo server only. Leave empty to have one generated: it is shown in this app's log at every start.

form_fields.label: Pairing page password
form_fields.hint: Optional. Turns on https://<domain>/pair, which shows the current pairing codes with a QR code, behind this password (any user name). Empty: no page.

form_fields.label: Pairing page from outside the home network
form_fields.hint: Off: the pairing page answers home-network addresses only.
